_comment: Copy file nay thanh bluecheck_config.json roi dien secret. File THAT khong bao gio commit.
_huong_dan: 1. Tao token: npx wrangler secret put BLUECHECK_TOKEN
3. Dien 'token', va dien proxy neu chay tren VPS
4. Chay: python bluecheck_watcher.py --once de thu, bo --once de chay lien tuc
_proxy_comment: Bo trong proxy_server neu chay bang IP may. Dien khi chay tren VPS.
_proxy_note: Proxy phai la IP TINH (ISP/residential). Proxy xoay lam ket qua chong tin cay hon IP may ban.
_timezone_comment: Khop voi quoc gia cua proxy. Vi du Romania thi Europe/Bucharest.
